t: This is Saint John Bosco College, a Roman Catholic secondary school and sixth form for boys and girls, in Battersea, in the London Borough of Wandsworth. The school is named for John Bosco, the nineteenth-century Italian priest known as Don Bosco. Working in Turin, he gave his life to street children, young offenders and other disadvantaged youth. He developed teaching methods based on love rather than punishment, which became known as the Salesian Preventive System. That idea of education through care is the name the school carries.
